player_directive: Valerius responds to all incoming messages and petitions, returns the last injured man to duty following his recovery, and announces his participation as a candidate in the lowest-level next civic election.

events.title: VALERIUS ANSWERS THE MESSAGES THAT HAVE REACHED HIS ESTATE
events.body: Valerius gives written answers to the outstanding messages and petitions that have accumulated around the estate. To Quintus Caecilius Metellus Celer, he explains that admission beneath the estate’s shield remains a decision of Valerius and his appointed stewards, while the armed guard remains under his direct authority and Titus Varenus’s orders; protection of a refugee is not a grant of political office or independent military standing. To the smallholders, he answers that the shared-water road is to remain open to ordinary local traffic as well as caravans and that no toll is to be imposed merely for passage. He further instructs that the patrols are to protect those using the route without turning the road into a private checkpoint system. The replies close the immediate correspondence loop without ending the broader political questions surrounding the estate’s growing role. The written responses are carried outward by the same messengers who brought the requests, leaving the recipients to decide what they make of Valerius’s stated principles.

events.title: THE LAST RECOVERING MAN RETURNS TO DUTY
events.body: The final man still listed as temporarily unavailable completes his recovery and is returned to ordinary duty. Valerius orders that his return be treated as a restoration of an existing soldier rather than as new recruitment, and Titus Varenus places him on a lighter patrol assignment before returning him to the normal rotation. With the man restored, the temporarily unavailable count falls from 1 to 0 while the established force remains 414 soldiers. The patrol corridor therefore reaches full personnel availability without any increase in the authorized establishment. The veteran rejoins men who had continued the road watch while he recovered, turning what had been a medical absence into a quiet restoration of the original guard strength. No new formation is created and no additional military expenditure is required.

events.title: VALERIUS DECLARES FOR THE LOWEST-LEVEL NEXT ELECTION
events.body: Valerius publicly announces that he will participate as a candidate in the next election for the lowest-level civic office currently due to be filled on the local electoral calendar. He deliberately begins at the lowest level rather than presenting himself for a higher magistracy before establishing a public political record within the community. The announcement is framed as participation in civic government, not as a claim to an office he has not yet won. Messengers and local political contacts begin carrying the news beyond the estate, where it becomes a new subject of conversation among men already familiar with his military and commercial activities. No election has yet occurred, no opponent has been displaced, and no result is assumed. The candidacy therefore enters the simulation as an active political development whose consequences will depend on the campaign and the eventual vote.

events.title: THE FIFTH SURPLUS SETTLEMENT PASSES THROUGH THE PATROL CORRIDOR
events.body: The fifth completed settlement under the recurring surplus-delivery agreement is realized as another consignment travels through the shared-water route. The delivery produces 30 denarii in gross receipts and incurs 11 denarii in operating costs, leaving 19 denarii of realized net public profit. Under the standing financial rule, 1.9 denarii is transferred to Valerius’s private account and 17.1 denarii remains in the public account. The patrols observe the movement as part of their ordinary corridor duty, while the merchants continue to use the route without a toll being charged. The settlement is recorded only for the delivery actually completed, with no future receipts pre-booked. The agreement therefore continues to function as an established commercial relationship rather than an assumed stream of guaranteed income.

events.title: THE ROAD BEGINS TO SERVE THE ESTATE’S NEIGHBORS AS WELL AS ITS MERCHANTS
events.body: Following Valerius’s response to the smallholders, ordinary agricultural traffic begins using the protected road alongside the merchant traffic already established there. Small carts carrying produce and tools pass through the patrol corridor without being stopped for payment, while the guards continue to distinguish routine travelers from any movement that genuinely requires inspection. Titus Varenus adjusts the patrol schedule so that the local traffic periods receive the same visible protection as the merchant movements. The change requires no new road construction and no additional guard recruitment, but it gives practical meaning to Valerius’s decision that the route should not become a private toll road. Merchants and smallholders now share the same protected artery while the estate continues to retain control over its own property boundaries. The road’s social function consequently begins expanding beyond the commercial purpose that first made it valuable.

events.title: SERVILIUS AND CASSIUS TRACE THE SECONDARY ALIGNMENT FURTHER
events.body: Publius Servilius and Numerius Cassius continue tracing the secondary alignment discovered beside the older prepared roadwork. Their latest measurements establish that the branch follows a deliberately maintained line for part of its course before becoming indistinct near rougher ground. The evidence strengthens the conclusion that the older work was organized rather than accidental, but still does not establish who ordered it or why. Servilius therefore sends Valerius another measured report instead of attaching a political explanation to the discovery. Cassius marks the points at which the older construction can still be followed so that future examinations can begin from known positions rather than repeating the same ground. The investigation remains open, but its geographic record is becoming more precise with each survey.

events.title: THE ELECTION ANNOUNCEMENT REACHES THE POLITICAL CIRCLE
events.body: News of Valerius’s candidacy begins circulating among the political connections already aware of his estate, military guard, commercial activity, and recent protection policy. Nearby landowners discuss the unusual combination of a candidate whose public profile has been built through private estate administration and whose first declared electoral step is at the lowest level of the local civic hierarchy. Celer’s circle receives the announcement as well, giving his earlier questions about Valerius’s authority a new political context without creating a formal alliance between them. No organized faction, office, endorsement, or election result is established during the round. The immediate consequence is informational: more people now understand that Valerius intends to enter civic life through the electoral process. The campaign has begun as a public fact, while its eventual support remains unresolved.

continuity.campaign_development: 9 November 57 BCE: Valerius answered the outstanding messages, the final recovering man returned to duty, Valerius declared for the lowest-level next civic election, the fifth recurring surplus settlement realized 30 gross / 11 costs / 19 net with 1.9 privately transferred and 17.1 retained publicly, ordinary local traffic expanded on the protected road, the older-road survey continued, and the candidacy entered local political discussion.
continuity.commercial_thread: The long-term surplus-delivery agreement remains active; the fifth contracted consignment settled this round for 30 gross / 11 costs / 19 net. No future receipts are booked.
continuity.road_thread: The shared-water road remains in routine local and merchant use and is covered by an unbroken patrol corridor from the lake port through the water-access approach.
continuity.road_investigation: Servilius and Cassius continue tracing the secondary alignment beside older prepared roadwork; builder, date, authority, and original purpose remain unresolved.
continuity.political_correspondence: Valerius answered Celer’s questions: sanctuary admission remains under Valerius and his appointed stewards, while the guard remains under his direct authority and Varenus’s orders. No office, payment, command, or binding political commitment exists.
continuity.medical_recovery: All previously unavailable men have now returned to duty; temporary unavailable strength is 0.
continuity.refuge_policy: The accepted refugee household remains under the estate shield as protected residents; protection does not alter property boundaries or grant unrestricted access to armed quarters.
continuity.election_thread: Valerius has publicly declared his candidacy in the lowest-level civic election currently next on the local electoral calendar. No election result, endorsement, office, or political alliance is yet established.
continuity.local_infrastructure_thread: The shared-water road remains toll-free for ordinary local traffic as well as merchant traffic; no new construction expenditure occurred this round.
continuity.personal_guard: 100 total: 50 infantry and 50 cavalry; all personnel are now available for ordinary duty.
